correctness.rationale: Independent reconstruction of the 30 duad+syntheme vertices, 45 incidence edges and shortest-path distances proves all 15x15 cross-class pairs are at distance≤3, while same-class edges give the duad-disjointness and syntheme-shared-duad graphs. Therefore K=A*B equivariantly. Both factor clique complexes comprise 15 triangles meeting at vertices and each contracts S6-equivariantly to the incidence graph, of first Betti rank E-V+1=45-30+1=16. Oriented bipartite edge fixed-character computation for all 720 permutations gives χ_H1(g)=#fixed flags−#fixed duads−#fixed synthemes+1: identity16, (3,3)=-2, (5,1)=1, (3,1,1,1)=-2, other cycle types0. Independently computed Frobenius alternant Specht characters to check this is the 16-dim irreducible S^(3,2,1). Equivariant join Künneth gives H3=S^(3,2,1)⊗S^(3,2,1), dimension256. Character inner products reproduce all eleven claimed irreducible multiplicities, including trivial and sign each once. Valid over Q for the natural class-preserving S6 only; no assertion under outer graph automorphisms.
